toolsets.desc: These functions help the AI assistant inspect its state as it relates to the larger Unreal Editor.

tools.desc: Returns important information about the current project and/or current user.

Returns information about the part of the unreal UI that the assistant is docked into. For example, if the assistant is docked with a Blueprint asset editor, this returns the Blueprint asset that is being edited, which graph is in focus, etc.  If the assistant is closed or not docked to an asset editor, this information will be empty.
